game.title: Saints Row: The Third
game.blurb: Open-world action game in which the Third Street Saints take on the city of Steelport, from Volition, released 2011-11-15. RAWG average playtime: 14 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The Saints arrive in Steelport and fight for it across four acts, with choices at the end of some acts. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: City Takeover
chapters.summary: Taking over districts, destroying gang operations, upgrading a stronghold and exploring every hood.

chapters.title: Activities, Assassinations and Challenges
chapters.summary: Insurance Fraud, Trafficking, Heli Assault, Mayhem, Escort, Snatch, Trail Blazing, Guardian Angel and more, plus hit targets, vehicle thefts and challenges.

chapters.title: Collectibles and Customisation
chapters.summary: Collectibles, upgrades, weapon and vehicle upgrades, and playing as both a male and female character.

chapters.title: Combat and Mayhem
chapters.summary: Brutes, gang members, taunts, hijacks and silly weapons.

chapters.title: Co-op and Online
chapters.summary: Co-op play, co-op missions and activities, and sharing a character online.

chapters.title: Genki Bowl VII (add-on)
chapters.summary: The add-on activities: Super Ethical PR Opportunity, Sad Panda Skyblazing, Apocalypse Genki and Sexy Kitten Yarngasm.

chapters.title: Gangstas in Space (add-on)
chapters.summary: Filming a space movie: a rescue scene, a spacecraft chase, Space Amazons and hidden clapboards.

chapters.title: The Trouble With Clones (add-on)
chapters.summary: Weird Science, Tour de Farce, Saints Flow and the Magarac Bridge.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Saints_Row:_The_Third
Fandom (saintsrow.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://saintsrow.fandom.com/wiki/Saints_Row:_The_Third
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). The Steam app used is the original Saints Row: The Third (55230), which matches the expected RAWG entry; Saints Row: The Third Remastered (978300, 79 achievements) is also in the store list. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0, but its walkthrough pages are actually written: Prologue and Acts 1 to 4 (about 3,200, 13,200, 8,200, 8,800 and 9,500 characters), plus "Achievements and trophies", "Cheats", "Controls", "Gameplay", "Respect", "Walkthrough" and "Table of Contents". Its Weapons, Car Upgrades, DLC, Collectibles, Activities and Saints Book pages are linked but not written. Because the brief asks for completion stage 1 or higher, it was not marked as used; it may deserve a second look. saintsrow.fandom.com answers the API, with about 181 linked pages, including "Gangstas in Space (DLC)", "The Trouble With Clones" and "Genkibowl VII"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 83 achievements is hidden. The three add-on chapters are placed by the add-on names and places in the achievement text (achievements 54 to 83).
